items.question: What do the local departments of finance in the UAE supervise?
items.gold: All financial and accounting affairs of the UAE local governments.
items.fact: Local finance departments supervise financial and accounting affairs of local governments.

items.question: Which body handles local finance oversight for Umm Al Quwain among the UAE local departments of finance?
items.fact: Umm Al Quwain's local finance body is named Financial Audit Department.
